quests.title: BATCH NINETEEN
quests.allDone: It was never the animals. Four years of it, and a hundred gold a barrel.

steps.text: THE SQUARE — you are off the road. Look around.
why: UR
The oldest working pad in the city, and a town built round it.

steps.text: FIVE OF THEM, in the square — and Sarru is shouting
why: MONSTERS IN THE SQUARE
Five of them, wearing collars, and nobody here has seen the like.

steps.text: SARRU, in the square — he took something off one of the bodies
why: THE COLLAR
One of the townsfolk pulled a collar off one of them.

steps.text: ENHEDU, at the college — the collar says COLLEGE PROPERTY
why: TEST BATCH 19
The stamp says the college owns them. Ask the college.

steps.text: THE PICKET, outside the lab — they have been here since the escape
why: THE LAB
The college never ran a batch 19. Some of its professors work at the lab.

steps.text: ADAPA, inside the lab — the fox who signs for the programme
why: THE DIRECTOR
The protesters say mutant attack animals. The lab says accident.

steps.text: SPECIMEN ONE, at the hunter’s cabin past the beast runs — clear the runs and cut out the chip
why: THE BIG ONE
Adapa wants the microchips out of the one that grew.

steps.text: ADAPA, at the lab again — she is paying for what is in your pack
why: THE DATA
Four chips along the spine, and two of them burst.

steps.text: THE SECOND CHAMBER — the lab needs crystal and the easy crystal is gone
why: THE SECOND CHAMBER
The seam is behind the brick — and something is standing over it.

steps.text: THE MACHINE, at the lab — hand over the crystal and watch it fire
why: THE SIGNAL
Adapa says this calms them. She is about to find out.

steps.text: THE PICKET again — they know something Adapa will not say
why: IT DID NOT WORK
The signal fired and nothing calmed. Somebody outside knows why.

steps.text: THE LAKE — three foxes and a cart, and the cart is not empty
why: THE WATER
It is not the breeding. It is the runoff, and somebody is pouring it.

steps.text: THE STORAGE, south of the lab — their key opens it
why: THE CLEAN LAKE
A house on clean water, and a padlock newer than the door it is on.

steps.text: TWENTY BARRELS, and the foxes who stacked them
why: THE STORAGE
Counted, numbered, and signed for. Somebody keeps a tally.

steps.text: UNA, in the throne room — the note names her
why: THE CASTLE
They are frightened of exactly one fox in Ur. Show her why.

quests.title: THE WATER
quests.allDone: Blue all the way down, and there are fish in it again.

steps.text: THE LAKE — Una wants a bottom you can see
why: THE WATER
Four years of barrels went into it. The skimmer is on the shore.

quests.title: WHAT THE HUNTER COUNTED
quests.allDone: Three collars, three animals, one number.

steps.text: Bring down three collared Lab Lizards in the beast runs
Take the collars back to Bel-shunu at the pond

quests.title: A BAR OF GOOD IRON
quests.allDone: A mountain’s worth, a bit at a time, for years.

steps.text: Collect three lumps of grey slag from the lake shore
Take the slag to Dagan at the armory

quests.title: QUIETLY, PLEASE
quests.allDone: And a reading of the monolith, which is the part that matters.

steps.text: Ask Zamu in the square about the third survey
Zamu sold it to Ishtu. Get it back.
Take the tablet back to Enhedu

quests.title: THE MACHINE AT THE BACK
quests.allDone: Eleven years full, and it only ever wanted five at once.

steps.text: Find five brass tokens. They turn up everywhere.
Take the five tokens to Sabra in the tavern
THE BACK ROOM — Adapa’s key opens the door at the rear of the lab
why: ONE MORE FAVOUR
The door at the back. Take the test room apart.

steps.text: THE TEST ROOM — and there are two of them behind you
A CAGE — and the only thing you can do in one is think
why: CAGE FOUR
The door is shut. The only thing you can do is meditate.

steps.text: THE PAD — Hope says the lab is aiming something at the ship
why: GET OFF THIS PLANET
The pad is in the middle of the square.

urBeastRunA.label: Beast Run
urBeastRunA.note: The pens are standing open and rusted that way.
urBeastRunA.intro: The pens are standing open and rusted that way.

arena.role: final stand — the path leaves its east side for ur-hunters-pond

urHuntersPond.label: Hunters Pond
urHuntersPond.note: Two tallies on the racks, and they have never matched.
urHuntersPond.intro: Two tallies on the racks, and they have never matched.

urLabPath.label: Lab Path
urLabPath.note: There is a picket on the lab steps and it has been there nine days.
urLabPath.intro: There is a picket on the lab steps and it has been there nine days.
urLabPath.name: Ur Lab Path

urLabVault.label: Lab Vault
urLabVault.note: Eight cages and a manifest. Kish wants a count.
urLabVault.intro: Eight cages and a manifest. Kish wants a count.

urTownSquare.label: Ur Town Square
urTownSquare.note: The oldest working pad in the city, and a town built round it.
urTownSquare.intro: The oldest working pad in the city, and a town built round it.
urTownSquare.name: Ur Town Square

urToxicLake.label: Toxic Lake
urToxicLake.note: Four outfalls, and only one of them is running.
urToxicLake.intro: Four outfalls, and only one of them is running.

urGauntlet.label: The Gauntlet
urGauntlet.note: THE GAUNTLET. The transport was interrupted here. Hold the ground and it will finish the crossing.
urGauntlet.intro: BATTLE. Machines and raiders are coming for the core. Hold it through three waves: fight them off, use the cover, and take out the turrets.
urGauntlet.name: The Gauntlet

urPyramidInt2.label: Pyramid, Second Chamber
urPyramidInt2.note: The stair head was never sealed. Something up here is still standing.
urPyramidInt2.intro: The stair head was never sealed. Something up here is still standing.

urPyramidGate.label: Pyramid, The Gate Hall
urPyramidGate.note: Three rings in the floor, and all three of them are turning.
urPyramidGate.intro: Three rings in the floor, and all three of them are turning.

urCleanLake.label: The Clean Lake
urCleanLake.note: Water you can see the bottom of. Somebody keeps a house on it.
urCleanLake.intro: Water you can see the bottom of. Somebody keeps a house on it.

urWarehouse.label: The Storage
urWarehouse.note: Twenty barrels, counted and numbered, and somebody counted them.

urSpacedock.label: Ur Spacedock
urSpacedock.note: High above Ur. Your ship is berthed at the end of the gantry. Walk to the teleporter at the far end and it beams you down to the crest pad.
urSpacedock.intro: High above Ur. Your ship is berthed at the end of the gantry. Walk to the teleporter at the far end and it beams you down to the crest pad.
urSpacedock.name: Ur Spacedock

npcs.name: Ishtu
npcs.greeting: Anything off the pyramid road, I will look at. Anything from the lake, I will not.
npcs.bio: Keeps the shop on the square. Buys curiosities off anyone coming back from the pyramid and resells them at a markup she calls fair.

npcs.name: Dagan
npcs.greeting: Small room. Big anvil. Tell me what you want on it.
npcs.bio: Beats plate in a room the size of a cellar and says a big forge is a sign of a smith who wastes steps.

npcs.name: Sabra
npcs.greeting: Sit where you like. The machine at the back eats tokens and gives nothing.
npcs.bio: Runs the tavern by the square. Keeps the skee-ball working out of what she describes as spite.

npcs.name: Enhedu
npcs.greeting: Quietly, please. Ask me anything; ask it quietly.
npcs.bio: Runs the college desk. Has read everything anyone has brought out of the pyramid and believes about a third of it.

npcs.name: Kish
npcs.greeting: Sign in. Do not open the north door. Both of those are rules.
npcs.bio: Minds the lab desk and the log book. Will not discuss what is in the vault, and will not pretend there is nothing in it either.

npcs.name: Steward Una

lines.text: Lugal.
You came through the square, so you have seen the pad. That is the oldest thing we have that still works.
The pyramid is older and does not. Be careful which of the two you spend your time on.

npcs.bio: Holds Ur, and is the reason the two notes in your pack are written the way they are. Funds the college and the lab in that order and is reminded of it by both.

npcs.name: Captain Shulgi

lines.text: Captain.
The runs were pens once. Whatever the lab was keeping in them is out, and it breeds.
Fight them on the road where you can see. Never in the reeds.

npcs.bio: Runs the barracks. Sends a patrol down the beast runs twice a day and has stopped pretending it is enough.

npcs.name: Ninshar

lines.text: You hunt the runs?
Twice a week. The little ones are nothing. It is the tall ones with the clubs I want a word with somebody about.
They were made. You do not get a collar with a number on it by accident.
Any advice out there?
Keep the road at your back and never let one of the tall ones get you at spitting range.
The acid goes for your eyes. Ask me how I know, then buy the round.

npcs.bio: Works the beast runs for the bounty and keeps a tally of what came out of the pens that the lab says never went in.

npcs.name: Eresh

lines.text: How far in have you been?
Three chambers past where the map stops. I go with rope, chalk, and somebody at this statue who knows when to fetch help.
Today that somebody is nobody, so today I am standing here.
What is in there?
Air that has not moved in a very long time, and something that has.
If you go in, count your turns. The false passage is convincing and it is meant to be.

npcs.bio: Ur's tomb guide. Has been deeper into the pyramid than the college has records for, and files a report every time anyway.

npcs.name: Bel-shunu

lines.text: You keep tallies.
Two of them. Up the run, and back down it. They have never matched and I have stopped expecting them to.

npcs.bio: Keeps two tallies on the drying racks: what goes up the run past him, and what comes back down it. They have never matched.

npcs.name: Ilshu

lines.text: You run the cage.
I run the cage. Everything in this city that is worth knowing about a fight, I will tell you in it and not out here.
Lead with the sword and I will put you down in four. Everybody leads with the sword.

npcs.bio: Runs the cage in the barracks. Has never once been beaten by anybody who led with the sword, and says so before the bout rather than after.

npcs.name: Nammu

lines.text: The animals have all gone mad. I won't go back in there, and my partner is trapped in his cabin on the other side of this path. If you promise to help him I WILL SEND YOU WITH MY SPEAR.

npcs.bio: Fed the pens for four years on lab wages. Stopped going in about the time they stopped asking him to clean them out.

npcs.name: Ur-Nanshe

lines.text: I am not going any further up this road, and neither is the cart.

npcs.bio: Drove the night cart eleven times, west, and was paid in coin with no mark on it. Has not been west since the eleventh.

npcs.name: Nanshe
npcs.bio: Has been outside the lab since the escape with a board and a list of questions, and is the only fox in Ur who wrote the questions down.

npcs.name: Kubaba
npcs.bio: Came for the shouting and stayed for the argument.

npcs.name: Lu-igi
npcs.bio: Holds the other end of the board. Has not said a word in four days.

npcs.name: Ur-Ninurta
npcs.bio: Stands on the step of a building he is not allowed to let anybody into, saying the same four sentences to a crowd that has learnt them.

npcs.name: Dr. Adapa
npcs.bio: Runs the Terracotta programme. Speaks about the escape the way you would speak about weather: regrettable, nobody’s doing, already being handled.

npcs.name: Ilku
npcs.bio: Backs a cart down to the water four nights a week and has never once been asked what is in it.

npcs.name: Bau
npcs.bio: Does the lifting. Does not do the talking, and would rather not be here for this part.

npcs.name: Shu-ilishu
npcs.bio: Carries the purse, which is how you know which of the three to talk to.

npcs.name: Ur-Shanabi
npcs.bio: Keeps the tally on the desk in a hand that has been taught to write, which is the most interesting thing in this building.

npcs.name: Girini
npcs.bio: Loads at night and sleeps in the afternoon, and has never once asked why the work is arranged that way.

npcs.name: Nabi
npcs.bio: Came for the money. Is still here for the money. Would go somewhere else for more of it.

npcs.name: Kubbutum
npcs.bio: Watches the track from the shutter that does not open, and has watched nobody come up it for four years.

npcs.name: Ur-Bau

lines.text: Quiet in here.
It is a throne room. It is supposed to be.
Though she has not sat down in nine days, and nobody has told me why.

npcs.bio: Stands the west alcove. Has stood it since the Steward’s father, and says the room has been quieter every year of it.

npcs.name: Ninlil

lines.text: Eyes front. Not on me.
Anyone been through here?
The lab’s director. Twice this month, and neither time by appointment.

npcs.bio: Stands the east alcove, which is the one nearer the treasury, and has opinions about who has been walking past it.

npcs.name: Puzur

lines.text: Long day?
We walked the lake road. Something came out of the reeds at us and it was wearing a collar.
The Captain wrote it down. That is the whole of what happened to it.

npcs.bio: Two months in. Was told the roads would be the dull part of it.

npcs.name: Ashgi

lines.text: Do not wake him. He has had the night wall three times running.
Short-handed?
Nine of us. Four watches. You can do that sum as well as I can.

npcs.bio: Keeps the watch board. There are nine of them and four watches, and she can tell you exactly how that goes.

npcs.name: Kuli

lines.text: …I am not on until the second watch.
What is out there?
If it has a collar on it you shout, and you do not close with it. That is the whole standing order.

npcs.bio: Off the night wall an hour ago and not due back on until the second watch, which he will tell you before he tells you anything else.

npcs.name: Kubatum

lines.text: What are you copying?
Requisitions. The lab’s. Iron, salt, rope — and the same three words at the bottom of every one.
WEST TRANSFER. I do not know what it means and I have written it four hundred times.

npcs.bio: Copies the lab’s requisitions into the ledger. Has written the same three words at the foot of four hundred of them.

npcs.name: Ku-Bau

lines.text: The shelf on the pyramid is one book, and it is the wrong one.
Wrong how?
It is a poem. There should be a survey. Somebody took the survey and left the poem.

npcs.bio: Came for the pyramid survey and found a poem where it should have been.

npcs.name: Shesh

lines.text: Studying?
Enhedu says I may read anything on the west wall and nothing on the east.
I have read the west wall.

npcs.bio: Has read everything Enhedu will let him read and is now working steadily through the rest.

npcs.name: Ubara

lines.text: He has put nine tokens in that machine tonight.
Nine?
Nine. He will tell you eight. It was nine.

npcs.bio: Counts other people’s tokens. Is right about the number more often than anybody at that table will admit.

npcs.name: Shala

lines.text: It was eight.
She says nine.
She says nine about everything. Ask her how many outfalls the lake has.

npcs.bio: It was eight.

npcs.name: Anu-banu

lines.text: Six years I worked those outfalls.
And?
And you do not want to know what colour the water went in the last of them. I stopped looking down.

npcs.bio: Six years on the outfalls. Left when they stopped telling him what he was standing in.

npcs.name: Anu-banu

lines.text: Somebody has been out on the water with a rake.
It is cleaner.
It LOOKS cleaner. I walked the outfalls this morning and every one of them is still running — so whatever you took off the top of it, something is making the waste still grow.
Stop the carts and I will believe the water. Not before.

npcs.bio: Six years on the outfalls. Left when they stopped telling him what he was standing in.

npcs.name: Anu-banu

lines.text: The water is blue.
It is.
I walked down to look at it twice this morning, because the first time I did not believe it.

npcs.bio: Six years on the outfalls, and has now been down to look at the water twice in one morning.

npcs.name: Ilu

lines.text: You work the anvil?
I work the bellows. Dagan works the anvil.
He says I get the iron when the iron gets here. It has not got here since the ninth.

npcs.bio: Works the bellows. Has been promised the anvil since spring, on the condition that the iron arrives.

npcs.name: Ibbi

lines.text: One of you on the whole gate?
Four watches, nine of us, and this road wants two. You do the sum they gave me.
Nothing has come up it yet. That is not the same as nothing being on it.

npcs.bio: The only fox on the castle road. Was told it was a two-fox post and has been standing it alone since the ninth.

npcs.name: Geme

lines.text: Ask him what rope costs this week. Go on, ask him.
What does rope cost?
It costs what the road costs. And the road costs whatever came out of the runs last night.

npcs.bio: Has been buying rope off Ishtu for eleven years and has never once agreed with him about what it costs.

npcs.name: Ku-bau

lines.text: Any chance you are looking for a job? We got great COFFEE here, super fun to make.

npcs.bio: Runs the bar on the end of the college. Opened it the week the lake went over and has not shut it since. Short of one pair of paws.

npcs.name: Ninshubur
npcs.bio: Has had a picture of the sphinx on a biscuit tin in her kitchen for twenty-two years and has now met it.

npcs.name: Puzur
npcs.bio: Bought the hat at the gate, is wearing it, and has decided not to be embarrassed about either of those things.

npcs.name: Bau
npcs.bio: Read every word about Ur before coming, and has spent the morning discovering that reading about it was not the same thing.

npcs.name: Shulgi
npcs.bio: Came for the gift shop and is currently unable to stop looking up.

npcs.name: Lugal

lines.text: Quiet post?
Quieter than the crossroads, and I had the crossroads until last week. Up here everybody who comes past has already decided to.
Ibbi and Enanna have the gate. Geme and I have the approach, one rank below them. Nothing gets up the middle of it unnoticed.

npcs.bio: West side of the castle approach, one rank below Ibbi. Stood the crossroads until they moved him up here, and mentions it.

npcs.name: Geme

lines.text: Four of you for one gate?
One on each side of the gate and one on each side of the road. You would be amazed what walks up the middle when there are only two of us.
And I can still see the pad from up here if I lean. Four pyramid hats off it this week, and every one of them came straight up this road.

npcs.bio: East side of the approach, opposite Lugal. Counts everything that goes up to the castle and writes none of it down.

npcs.name: Enanna

lines.text: Long shift?
Ibbi has the west side, I have the east, and between us we have the gate. Six years of it.
We ran out of things to say to each other in the second year. It is a very restful arrangement and I would not change it.

npcs.bio: The other side of the castle gate. Has stood opposite Ibbi for six years and the two of them have run out of things to say.

npcs.name: Sarru

lines.text: Good morning.
It is. The lake has not smelt since Tuesday, which counts as good.

npcs.bio: Sits by the pad most days and can tell you who went west and when.

npcs.name: Nin

lines.text: What is west?
The pyramid. Open at the bottom, and people do go in. Some come out.

npcs.bio: Copies tablets for the college and complains about the pay in detail.

npcs.name: Adab

lines.text: What is east?
The lab, past the beast runs. Do not stop on the runs.

npcs.bio: Runs errands between the lab and the castle and is fit because of it.

npcs.name: Iltani

lines.text: Nice fountain.
It is the pad. It was a fountain once. Nobody has changed the sign.

npcs.bio: Fishes the hunters' pond, which is legal, and the lake, which is not.

npcs.name: Ubar

lines.text: Hello.
College is through the far door if you want the long answer to anything.

npcs.bio: Sweeps the square. Has views about the tree the planters killed.

npcs.name: Zamu

lines.text: Who runs Ur?
The castle, north. Though the college thinks it does, and the lab knows it does.

npcs.bio: Was on the pyramid survey. Will not go back in and will not say why.

lines.text: Welcome to Ur, Steward.
Your ship is fuelled and berthed behind you. The teleporter at the end of the gantry puts you down on the crest pad in town.

topics.label: How do I get back to space?
replies: Walk back to your ship and board her. She will take you up to orbit.
